findings.message: The received file is a 1024x1536 PNG with SHA-256 8e50dc91c814e77da92f42cf5815ae783d771a748422dd430cf68ab3168d6d99 and contains Maribel Santos only.

Layout and core identifiers pass. The sheet contains exactly six separated studies in the required two-column, three-row order with consistent short silver-black hair, close sides, cat-eye reading glasses on a chain, linen blazer, plain blouse, trousers, archive-work hands, and the ink stain on Maribel's anatomical left cuff.

Build and age presentation do not meet the brief. The full-body studies use a narrow-waisted, long-legged fashion-model silhouette that reads younger and slimmer than the required sturdy, practical 44-year-old adult build. This also pushes the character toward the explicitly excluded glamorous presentation and would propagate the wrong body canon into later panels.

The outer shoulder and lower bust edges in the head studies dissolve through feathered gray texture. The locked reference finish excludes vignette-like fading and requires clean ink contours or crisp flat-tone boundaries on white paper.

The candidate otherwise preserves useful proposed identity details: dry observant expression, coherent short-hair construction, stable glasses and chain, practical archive clothing, readable hands and feet, matte monochrome rendering, and no environment, props, text, logo, signature, or watermark.

Maribel's reference remains storyboard-conditional and no approved storyboard currently confirms her visible appearance. Even a corrected visual candidate cannot be promoted until that condition and the normal approval requirements are satisfied.

The exact executed image job was not supplied and the Downloads filename omits the planned version suffix. A correction must be a distinct file named maribel-santos-reference-v002.png rather than overwriting or promoting this candidate.
No image was edited, regenerated, converted, renamed, or promoted. The Downloads original remains unchanged and a byte-identical copy is retained only as internal review evidence.
